cond_0001.intro: You will be part of the Indication team and will work closely with other actuaries to review and enhance the indication process of our commercial and specialty products. Your primary responsibility will be to provide sound pricing indication recommendations to the Product Manager who is responsible for the performance of these states. You will report to the Senior Manager, Actuary.
cond_0001.responsibilities: You will contribute to all aspects of indication development and owns the recurring process. You will provide technical background in support of rate filings with State Insurance departments; responds to and resolves regulatory questions. You will contribute to recommendations and significant revisions to one or more actuarial methodologies related to insurance pricing, ratemaking, loss reserving, modeling or reinsurance. You will develop relationships with core business partners and provide insights and solutions to address specific business concerns. You will explore new concepts statistical models, and data sources to deliver innovative solutions for the business. You will represent pricing on various data efforts including dataset development and consultation on data and analytical development. You will monitor industry and competitor trends to determine potential impact to actuarial strategies and solutions.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
2+ Years experience performing statistical/actuarial analysis and data forecasting and modeling techniques.
Extensive knowledge and understanding of property and casualty products, pricing, rates and industry trends.
Extensive knowledge and understanding of underwriting guidelines and concepts, pricing, ratemaking, loss reserving, modeling or reinsurance depending upon area of specialty.
Completion or near completion of Associate Casualty Actuary Society (ACAS).
Preferred Requirements
Extensive knowledge and understanding of forecasting and statistical analysis and modeling.
FCAS.

cond_0087.intro: You will be part of the Indication team and will work closely with other actuaries on a daily basis to review and enhance the indication process of our commercial and specialty products. Your primary responsibility will be to communicate sound pricing indication recommendations to the Product Manager who is responsible for the performance of these states. You will report to the Senior Manager, Actuary.
cond_0087.responsibilities:
You will actively contribute to all aspects of indication development and own the recurring process.
You will provide technical background in support of rate filings with State Insurance departments; you will engage directly with regulatory questions and work to resolve them.
You will contribute to recommendations and significant revisions to one or more actuarial methodologies related to insurance pricing, ratemaking, loss reserving, modeling or reinsurance.
You will build and maintain regular contact with core business partners, sharing insights and solutions to address specific business concerns.
You will explore new concepts, statistical models, and data sources, and bring findings back to the team to deliver innovative solutions for the business.
You will represent pricing on various data efforts, including dataset development and ongoing consultation on data and analytical development.
You will monitor industry and competitor trends and actively raise potential impacts to actuarial strategies and solutions.
cond_0087.requirements:
2+ Years experience performing statistical/actuarial analysis and data forecasting and modeling techniques.
Extensive knowledge and understanding of property and casualty products, pricing, rates and industry trends.
Extensive knowledge and understanding of underwriting guidelines and concepts, pricing, ratemaking, loss reserving, modeling or reinsurance depending upon area of specialty.
Extensive knowledge and understanding of forecasting and statistical analysis and modeling.
Completion or near completion of Associate Casualty Actuary Society (ACAS) required.
FCAS preferred.

cond_0135.responsibilities: You will collaborate on all aspects of indication development and share ownership of the recurring process. You will provide technical background in support of rate filings with State Insurance departments, and work with the team to respond to and resolve regulatory questions. You will contribute to recommendations and significant revisions to one or more actuarial methodologies related to insurance pricing, ratemaking, loss reserving, modeling or reinsurance. You will build relationships with core business partners and work together to provide insights and solutions that address specific business concerns. You will explore new concepts, statistical models, and data sources to help deliver innovative solutions for the business. You will coordinate with pricing and data teams on various data efforts including dataset development and consultation on data and analytical development. You will share findings on industry and competitor trends to help assess potential impact to actuarial strategies and solutions.

Minimum Requirements
2+ Years experience performing statistical/actuarial analysis and data forecasting and modeling techniques.
Extensive knowledge and understanding of property and casualty products, pricing, rates and industry trends.
Extensive knowledge and understanding of forecasting and statistical analysis and modeling.
Completion or near completion of Associate Casualty Actuary Society (ACAS).
Preferred Requirements
Extensive knowledge and understanding of underwriting guidelines and concepts, pricing, ratemaking, loss reserving, modeling or reinsurance depending upon area of specialty.
FCAS.

cond_0319.intro: You will be part of the Indication team and will work closely with other actuaries to review and enhance the indication process of our commercial and specialty products. Your primary responsibility will be to provide sound pricing indication recommendations to the Product Manager who is responsible for the performance of these states. You will report to the Senior Manager, Actuary. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of actuarial pricing and indication work.
cond_0319.responsibilities: You will contribute to all aspects of indication development and owns the recurring process. You will provide technical background in support of rate filings with State Insurance departments; responds to and resolves regulatory questions. You will contribute to recommendations and significant revisions to one or more actuarial methodologies related to insurance pricing, ratemaking, loss reserving, modeling or reinsurance. You will develop relationships with core business partners and provide insights and solutions to address specific business concerns. You will explore new concepts statistical models, and data sources to deliver innovative solutions for the business. You will represent pricing on various data efforts including dataset development and consultation on data and analytical development. You will monitor industry and competitor trends to determine potential impact to actuarial strategies and solutions.
cond_0319.requirements:
2+ Years experience performing statistical/actuarial analysis and data forecasting and modeling techniques.
Extensive knowledge and understanding of property and casualty products, pricing, rates and industry trends.
Extensive knowledge and understanding of underwriting guidelines and concepts, pricing, ratemaking, loss reserving, modeling or reinsurance depending upon area of specialty.
Extensive knowledge and understanding of forecasting and statistical analysis and modeling.
Completion or near completion of Associate Casualty Actuary Society (ACAS) required.
FCAS preferred.

cond_0448.intro: You will be part of the Indication team and will coordinate with other actuaries to review and enhance the indication process of commercial and specialty products. Your primary responsibility will be to provide sound pricing indication recommendations to the Product Manager who is responsible for the performance of these states. You will report to the Senior Manager, Actuary.
cond_0448.responsibilities:
You will contribute to all aspects of indication development and own the recurring process.
You will provide technical background in support of rate filings with State Insurance departments; respond to and resolve regulatory questions.
You will contribute to recommendations and significant revisions to one or more actuarial methodologies related to insurance pricing, ratemaking, loss reserving, modeling or reinsurance.
You will coordinate with core business partners to provide insights and solutions that address specific business concerns.
You will explore new concepts, statistical models, and data sources to deliver solutions for the business.
You will serve as the pricing point of contact on data efforts including dataset development and consultation on data and analytical development.
You will monitor industry and competitor trends to assess potential impact on actuarial strategies and solutions.
cond_0448.requirements:
2+ Years experience performing statistical/actuarial analysis and data forecasting and modeling techniques.
Extensive knowledge and understanding of property and casualty products, pricing, rates and industry trends.
Extensive knowledge and understanding of underwriting guidelines and concepts, pricing, ratemaking, loss reserving, modeling or reinsurance depending upon area of specialty.
Extensive knowledge and understanding of forecasting and statistical analysis and modeling.
Completion or near completion of Associate Casualty Actuary Society (ACAS) required.
FCAS preferred.

You will report to the Senior Manager, Actuary. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with actuarial analysis and pricing work.
cond_0464.responsibilities:
Primary Accountabilities
You will contribute to all aspects of indication development and owns the recurring process. You will provide technical background in support of rate filings with State Insurance departments; responds to and resolves regulatory questions. You will contribute to recommendations and significant revisions to one or more actuarial methodologies related to insurance pricing, ratemaking, loss reserving, modeling or reinsurance. You will develop relationships with core business partners and provide insights and solutions to address specific business concerns. You will explore new concepts statistical models, and data sources to deliver innovative solutions for the business. You will represent pricing on various data efforts including dataset development and consultation on data and analytical development. You will monitor industry and competitor trends to determine potential impact to actuarial strategies and solutions.
cond_0464.requirements:
2+ Years experience performing statistical/actuarial analysis and data forecasting and modeling techniques.
Extensive knowledge and understanding of property and casualty products, pricing, rates and industry trends.
Extensive knowledge and understanding of underwriting guidelines and concepts, pricing, ratemaking, loss reserving, modeling or reinsurance depending upon area of specialty.
Extensive knowledge and understanding of forecasting and statistical analysis and modeling.
Completion or near completion of Associate Casualty Actuary Society (ACAS) required.
FCAS preferred.

Your primary responsibility will be to provide sound pricing indication recommendations to the Product Manager who is responsible for the performance of these states. You will report to the Senior Manager, Actuary. Most people become stronger in this kind of actuarial work over time as they build experience and learn from feedback.
cond_0509.responsibilities: You will contribute to all aspects of indication development and owns the recurring process. You will provide technical background in support of rate filings with State Insurance departments; responds to and resolves regulatory questions. You will contribute to recommendations and significant revisions to one or more actuarial methodologies related to insurance pricing, ratemaking, loss reserving, modeling or reinsurance. You will develop relationships with core business partners and provide insights and solutions to address specific business concerns. You will explore new concepts statistical models, and data sources to deliver innovative solutions for the business. You will represent pricing on various data efforts including dataset development and consultation on data and analytical development. You will monitor industry and competitor trends to determine potential impact to actuarial strategies and solutions.
cond_0509.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
2+ Years experience performing statistical/actuarial analysis and data forecasting and modeling techniques.
Completion or near completion of Associate Casualty Actuary Society (ACAS).
Extensive knowledge and understanding of property and casualty products, pricing, rates and industry trends.
Extensive knowledge and understanding of underwriting guidelines and concepts, pricing, ratemaking, loss reserving, modeling or reinsurance depending upon area of specialty.
Preferred Requirements
Extensive knowledge and understanding of forecasting and statistical analysis and modeling.
FCAS.

You will report to the Senior Manager, Actuary.
cond_0611.responsibilities:
You will own all aspects of indication development and drive the recurring process.
You will provide technical background in support of rate filings with State Insurance departments; responds to and resolves regulatory questions.
You will lead recommendations and significant revisions to one or more actuarial methodologies related to insurance pricing, ratemaking, loss reserving, modeling or reinsurance.
You will build relationships with core business partners and deliver insights and solutions to address specific business concerns.
You will explore new concepts, statistical models, and data sources to execute innovative solutions for the business.
You will represent pricing on various data efforts including dataset development and consultation on data and analytical development.
You will monitor industry and competitor trends to determine potential impact to actuarial strategies and solutions.
cond_0611.requirements:
2+ Years experience performing statistical/actuarial analysis and data forecasting and modeling techniques.
Extensive knowledge and understanding of property and casualty products, pricing, rates and industry trends.
Extensive knowledge and understanding of underwriting guidelines and concepts, pricing, ratemaking, loss reserving, modeling or reinsurance depending upon area of specialty.
Extensive knowledge and understanding of forecasting and statistical analysis and modeling.
Completion or near completion of Associate Casualty Actuary Society (ACAS) required.
FCAS preferred.
